capex_on_investment.note: a sensitivity readout, not a new default: the capex channel keyed to investment / income (delta Vm K / income) in place of the pace of tasks moving; the investment term is linear in the coefficient (alpha_inv x the change in investment / income), so alpha_capex's 0.25 used unconverted (the first switch report) gives 0.25 / alpha_inv times each scale's term, between the two; debt and policy stay on the default r*
